ff_specs.Usual Effect: 'Actual' greater than 'Forecast' is good for currency
ff_specs.Frequency: Released monthly, about 11 days after the month ends
ff_specs.FF Notes: Food and energy prices account for about a quarter of CPI, but they tend to be very volatile and distort the underlying trend. The Federal Open Market Committee usually pays more attention to the Core data - so do traders
